the critical exponents and crossover behaviors of the BAAWs with finite and infinite range of attraction are different from each other, and that the origin of the difference is the long-range attraction.
the critical behaviors of the BAAWs are determined by the range of attraction and that as far as this range is finite, they belong to the DI universality class.
